proposals.before: He clashed with Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Asi over policy and, falling under suspicion, was sent out as Grand Protector of the Horse Herds.
proposals.after: He clashed with Commissioner of Military Affairs Yelu Asi over policy and, being resented by him, was sent out as Grand Protector of the Horse Herds.
proposals.reason: 見忌 means he was resented or viewed with hostility by Asi, not that he himself fell under unspecified suspicion.

proposals.before: It campaigned against Western Xia, attacked the Tangut, broke the Zubu, pacified the Dilie, and the tribes were all shaken with fear; at the sound of war drums their courage fell from their bellies and their leggings dropped — this may truly be called a fiercely martial state.
proposals.after: It campaigned against Western Xia, attacked the Tangut, broke the Zubu, pacified the Dilie, and the tribes were all shaken with fear; at the sound of war drums their courage failed and their thighs trembled — this may truly be called a fiercely martial state.
proposals.reason: 股弁 describes thighs trembling with fear, not leggings dropping; 膽落 is loss of courage.

decisions.reason: 見忌 after 與…論事不合 means Moluwo was resented or envied by Asi, not that he fell under vague suspicion; “being resented by him” restores that sense.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 與樞密使耶律阿思論事不合，見忌

decisions.reason: 膽落股弁 is courage failing and thighs trembling; “courage fell from their bellies and their leggings dropped” misreads both 膽落 and 股弁.
